services.name: After School Art Classes
services.desc: Join us for GDAC’s After School Art Class! If your child is looking for creative enrichment outside of the traditional classroom setting, this 12 week course is for them. Throughout the course students will be inspired by art history, be introduced to new skills in both 2D and 3D mediums, tour current art exhibitions on display at the GDAC, develop their own artistic voice, and create beautiful works of art while exploring real life themes! Family and friends of students in the Fall session are invited to join us for a special art exhibition on November 17th from 3:30-5:30pm where students will be able to show what they have created and the new skills they have learned! services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: The Greater Denton Arts Council invites Texas-based artists age 30 and under to apply for 30 Under 30, a GDAC Signature exhibition highlighting emerging voices shaping contemporary art across the state. This exhibition celebrates innovation across all media, from traditional forms to experimental and interdisciplinary practices. In past years, 30 Under 30 has featured works engaging with contemporary issues, identity, and new media-offering a dynamic snapshot of the ideas and perspectives driving the next generation of artists in Texas. services.desc: From exhibition receptions to art workshops to open mic nights to performance art and more, we host events and programs year round that are free and open to the public. services.desc: Welcome Paper Chair Studios cofounder and Executive Director, Joshua Steven Bryant, and treasurer, Max Marshall as our next Back Door Residents!Joshua Steven Bryant is an artist and educator based in Denton, TX. He makes interdisciplinary sculptures and paintings that stem from experiences with disability through chronic pain that left him largely immobile for two years. From that time spent reliant on seating, chairs have become a symbol across his work. Bryant’s process is a blend of abstraction and conceptualism, heavily intuitive and a way for him to process his experiences and research. He earned his MFA from the University of North Texas.
